    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in range(9)]
    for dr,dc,col,obj in [(2,5,chosen[0],chosen),(5,5,bottom[0],bottom)]:
        for r,c in obj[1]: out[dr+r][dc+c]=col
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    sep=next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if 5 in r)
    def shapes(ranges):
        pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in ranges for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
        result=[]
        for color in sorted(set(p[2] for p in pts)):
            q=[p for p in pts if p[2]==color]; r0=min(p[0] for p in q); c0=min(p[1] for p in q); r1=max(p[0] for p in q); c1=max(p[1] for p in q)
            result.append((color,{(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c,v in q},(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)))
        return result
    candidates=shapes(range(sep)); bottom=shapes(range(sep+1,len(grid)))[0]
    h,w=bottom[2]; full={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)}
    chosen=next(x for x in candidates if x[2]==bottom[2] and (x[1] | bottom[1])==full)
    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in range(9)]
    for dr,obj in [(2,chosen),(5,bottom)]:
        for r,c in obj[1]: out[dr+r][5+c]=obj[0]
    return out
'''
